planetShapes.description: Medium-sized planet with two satellites orbiting around its gravitational core.
Large planet that features a series of asteroid or ice rings orbiting around it.
These planets are of unusually large size and mass, and lack satellites of any kind.

table.text: Followed by an Epsilon Interceptor. Surrender 3 items (+1 Favor Corsair) or Attack (gain 2 Contraband Packages).

Stopped by a pirate Starpredator. Buy freedom for 120 Serum or Confront (gain 3 Contraband Packages if you win; {+2 Favor} deliver 1 Contraband Package to another Hideout for +1 Favor Corsair and a random melee weapon mod).
A Smuggler Speeder. Attack: take 40 Scraps, a random ranged weapon, and a Contraband Package. Items to ISF Settlement = +1 Favor ISF.
Pirate crew aboard a Snowstorm Delta. Confront (find 50 Scraps) or Flee to adjacent Middle Ring hex (lose 3 Fuel).
Veteran pilot in a Vector-7 Mantis. Escape through asteroid field (lose 3 Fuel) or Fight (gain 2 Frog Grenades).
Old World pirate military base with a first-gen A-1 Voyager in perfect condition. Replace your ship or take any of its modules.
Fast asteroids. ROLL GRACE - Success: dodge all {+1}. Failure: lose 5 Hull.
Cosmic debris field. Scavenge: 60 Scraps, an EMP Grenade, and a Taser Shell.
WARG cell in a secret base; a rebel Duskwing. Fight (random ranged weapon mod {+1 Serum}) or Explain you're an ally (reveal a WARG Settlement 2 tiles southeast).
Corsair outlaws racing. Buy Zero-G Liquor and Stardust Soda. Starship Race: 15 pts = random Master Hack, 12 pts = random weapon mod, 9 pts = random narcobiotic.
Synth Arch space station behind artificial asteroids. {+3 Favor} Deliver a Tesseract to a Synth Arch Settlement 3 tiles northwest.
Hidden smuggler stash. Find: 3 Testogre Hormones and 2 Tricillin Tablets.

planetShapes.description: Medium-sized planet that has a single observable satellite in orbit.
Small-sized planet with two satellites orbiting around its gravitational core.
Medium planet with no satellites, commonly found in the Circumstellar Habitable Zone.

table.text: ISF terraformer starship with Terraforming Seeds; planet 2 tiles south. Plant seeds on desert planet. {+1 Favor ISF}
Luxury staryacht needs 3 BurnPatches. Pay 50 Serum each.
Rotating colony ship, 80 people in cryo-pods, 7 months fuel. Wake them up (warn them) or Leave them (lose 7 Fuel {+2}).
Abandoned cyber-laboratory ship with a survivor. Take her to a Settlement; she gives a random HACK. {+1 Favor}
Tarrasque Titan ghost ship with 2 Looters. Bargain (pay 100 Serum) or Fight (find a Contraband Package).
A 125-year-old generation ship. Buy any items or Armor Sets.
Beluga Transporter used as a WARG explosive factory. Provide support (Pulse Rifle {+1 Favor WARG}) or Infiltrate (5 Frag grenades {-2 Favor}).
ISF checkpoint with ISF Soldiers. Everything in order (continue), Reveal cargo (all Contraband/narcobiotics taken {-1 Favor}), or Bribe with a Contraband Package (win an ISF Patron {-2 Favor}).
Research station with an escaped alien specimen. Help the scientist: fight the Deepworm. Gain a random HACK.
Synth Arch space station with a Synth Apostle. Yes (random cybertech {+1 Favor}) or No (synth attacks {-1 Favor}).
Computational research station, 3 NetHackers cracking NGHTMR. Help (ROLL MIND - gain 1 NGHTMR Key {+1 Favor}) or Fight (destroy station {-1 Favor}).
Fortified building, ATLAS PROJECT dossier. Spend 10 Energy for one implant: Titanium Bones, Forceblast Hand, or Trigger Fingers.

planetShapes.description: Small-sized planet with no orbiting moons, commonly found near the system's star.
Medium-sized planet that has a single observable satellite in orbit.
Surface partly corrupted by void, from a supernatural event or human experiment.

table.text: Temperature peaks. ROLL VIGOR - Success: escape {+1}. Failure: lose 6 Hull.
Fire columns from the star. ROLL GRACE - Success: evade {+1}. Failure: lose 3 Fuel and 4 Hull.
Ship compartment fire. ROLL TECH - Success: trigger airlock {+1}. Failure: lose 6 Health.
Solar radiation wave. ROLL MIND - Success: run anti-radiation {+1}. Failure: lose 5 Health and 4 Hull.
Massive solar flare. Take the hit (lose 8 Hull) or Spend fuel (lose 5 Fuel).
Distress signal from a Twinrotor Hauler 3 tiles northeast. Repair (gain 100 Serum) or Transport crew (2 Vesterone Stimulants and a Supranova Physic).
Corsair Syndicate offers smuggled Fuel. Wait in line (restore Fuel to 20, lose 5 Energy) or Pay (4 Serum per unit of Fuel).
Field of spherical energy receptors. Restore Energy by connecting.
Unfinished Dyson sphere ring. Restore 8 Energy and 6 Fuel.
RED SOL STATION fuel station. Refuel (3 Serum per Fuel) or Enter bar (buy Zero-G Liquor, Stardust Soda, narcobiotics).
Medusa Stingray Frontier with 3 Vector Ace Fighters. Fight ambush (cargo ship refuels to 20 Fuel {+1 Favor}) or Join attack (7 Fuel + random melee weapon {+1 Favor}).
Crescent solar farm, damaged terminal. ROLL TECH - Success: restore 10 Fuel. ROLL MIND - Success: restore 10 Energy.

ringEvents.note: Ring Events are the result 2 on the Exploration Roll. Outer -> ODD Pirate Hideout / EVEN Asteroid Sea. Middle -> ODD Star Cruiser / EVEN Research Outpost. Inner -> ODD Solar Flare / EVEN Helios Farm. Roll d6 on the matching table (result 1 leaves tile blank in events; see ring-specific tables above).

hostile.note: Roll a d8 - Result 1 = no encounter (leave tile blank, re-roll next visit). Results 2-6 then roll d6 below.

table.notes: Overloaded stolen ship with laser cuts on hatch
Mistook you for an ISF Trade Patrol
Warps in front of you, attacks immediately
Crown jewel of the largest pirate fleet
'Who do you work for?' - no answer
Bounty hunter; gain Combat Exoskeleton after defeating
Heretic androids from destroyed Synth Arch base

table.text: WARG Vector Ace Fighter + Vector-7 Mantis attack ISF Shell-4 Transporter. Fight the two fighters {+2 Favor}{-1} or Destroy the transporter {+1 Favor}{-1}.
Two Corsair Snowstorm Delta attack Medusa Stingray Frontier. Ambush the Stingray {+1 Favor}{-1} or Attack the Corsairs {+2 Favor}{-1}.
WARG Starpredator attacks Synth Arch Twinrotor Hauler. Destroy the Starpredator {+1 Favor}{-1} or Attack the Twinrotor {+1 Favor}{-1}.
Medusa Orion Moth fights Synth Arch Eclipse Warden. Fight the Eclipse Warden {+1 Favor}{-1} or Attack the Orion Moth {+1 Favor}{-1}.
ISF support request. 2 A-1 Voyagers battle a The Claw mothership. Attack the mothership {+1 Favor}{-1} or Destroy the two ISF ships {+2 Favor}{-1}.
Two Synth Arch Epsilon Interceptors attack ISF Tarrasque Titan. Attack the Tarrasque Titan {+1 Favor}{-1} or Fight the Interceptors {+2 Favor}{-1}.

neutral.note: Roll a d8 - Result 1 = no encounter. Results 2-6 then roll d6 below.

table.text: Pre-war fighter with skeleton pilot. Find: Ion Carbine + random ranged weapon mod.
Transport ship covered in ice. Find: 2 Health Packs.
Asteroid drilling ship. Find: 50 Serum in a locker.
Starship carrier split in half; defense turret activates. ROLL VIGOR - Success: destroy turret {+1}. Failure: lose 2d4 Health.
Two crashed interceptors. Salvage: 60 Scraps.
Contraband ship, 2 dead pirates. Find: 2 random narcobiotics + 100 Serum hidden stash.
Belug Transporter with artisan gunsmith. Buy any weapon or weapon mod.
Distress signal from a Belug Transporter. ROLL SKILL - Success: 30 Scraps and 70 Serum.
Wandering trader in a Twinrotor Hauler: lose 4 Health -> gain 80 Serum (up to 5 times).
Twinrotor Hauler at checkpoint. Buy any item or Armor Set.
Shell-4 Transporter, dead crew, empty cargo. Salvage: Disruptor Beams ship module.
Shell-4 Transporter with android clone crew. Buy any cybertech for Serum cost + 10 Energy (no EXP cost).
Scarab Interceptor with survivors. Give 100 Serum -> +1 Favor Medusa.
WARG revolutionaries in Vector-7 Mantis. Reveal a WARG Settlement location -> +1 Favor WARG.
Snowstorm Delta with refugees. Aid with 40 Scraps -> reveal Sylvanian planet 2 tiles north.
A-4 Voyager with 3 Voidcrawlers aboard. Reward if you help: 100 Serum + 50 Scraps.
Orion Moth drifts. Trade 5 Fuel -> receive a DRONE_Ladybug.
Edgecharger W ISF hospital ship. Donate 2 Health Packs -> +1 Favor ISF.
Nuclear warhead counting down toward a lunar colony. ROLL TECH - Success: save ship systems (+1 Favor). Failure: lose 8 Hull.
'The Quiet' EMP zone. Roll for a Hostile Encounter on the next unexplored hex.
Deep space resonance damages ship. ROLL TECH - Success: save systems (+1 Favor). Failure: lose 8 Hull.
Emergency signal: Synth Settlement 1 tile southwest taken by WARG.
Morse code in hexadecimal. ROLL MIND - Success: mark a Medusa Settlement 3 tiles northeast.
Low frequency signal playing 20th-century Old World music from a pirate radio station.
Comet approaches. Gain 10 EXP and restore Health and Energy to 20.
Voidcrawler breaks into fuel reserves. Attack/Fight/Let it feed -> creature teleports away. Lose 4 Fuel.
Navigation controls vibrate. Wake up 06 years younger.
Eclipse Warden ship speaks: 'WHAT LIGHT GUIDES YOUR PATH? MAY YOU FIND THE EMBRACE OF THE PROPHET BEFORE THE END.'
A pink crystal prism floats in the void. Touch it -> Gain a permanent +1 to a stat of your choice.
Strange electromagnetic field - ship transported to any hex of your choice.
